_note: Secret Vault water (Lib/VaultWater), in 1920x1080 pixels. render_scale: the render size against the drawn size (2/3) when the caller gives none; edge_px: the frame reaches this far past the drawn area (its texture wraps, so its outermost rows blend with the opposite side when scaled up); cull_margin_px: a surface this far below the drawn area, or a lower edge this far above it, draws nothing. Colours are [r, g, b] from 0 to 1, handed to the shader; caustics, shafts and specks are strengths (1 = full).
